blocks.text: MANDAUE CITY, Cebu – In the next six years, Talisay City Mayor Gerald Anthony Gullas Jr. wants to transform the city’s portion of the South Road Properties (SRP) into an economic corridor. Gullas said he envisioned the area expanding beyond gas stations to include restaurants, coffee shops, convenience stores and other commercial establishments that would cater to tourists passing through the area. To help realize this vision, he sought the assistance of members of the Talisay City Chamber of Commerce and Industry in crafting an investments code “that can encourage commercial development along the Talisay side of SRP.” READ: Talisay City […]...
